main_text.p:
men omnem, quia Christus ut Deus & homo mortalis habuit potestatem excellentiæ instituendi Sacramenta & miracula faciendi propriâ authoritate &c. sed solam illam potestatem Pontifici communicavit, quæ puro homini communicari poterat: Frustrà es, nec enim adhuc causam ipsam attingis. Nam quæstio est, utrum illa Pontificis potestas Regÿ, an Sacerdotalis muneris sit? Si Sacerdotalis tantùm, tùm nihil ad Christi regnum: sin prorsus Regÿ, tum nihil ad Sacerdotem. Et profectò Sacerdotale Christi officiū totum spirituale fuit, temporale verò nullo modo, nè indirectè quidem; cuius Pastoratus partem potissimâ exercuit, non quidem Actiuâ,in Deponendis Principibus; sed potius Passiuâ illâ, quâ ipse a Ioh.10.11.{a}Pastor bonus vitam dedit pro ovibus suis. Denique Regnum & potestas Christi, quod{b} Extendit se ad temporalia, quatenus ad spiritualia ordinantur, ut omnes Theologi (inquis) fatentur, non erat spirituale, quatenus spirituale, à divino distinguitur (ut Tu, mirus sed &, ut{c} vestri confitentur, Infelix distinctionum Architectus{c} c Marsil.Venet.de-fens. commentus es) sed planè diuinum, Christi hominis, ratione Hypostaticæ Unionis: quod est secundum membrum diuisionis tuæ, quo dominia temporalia non tolluntur, sed reguntur, & diriguntur ipsius numine & nutu, qui{d} Rex Regum, & Dominus Dominantium tam in corda, quàm in corpora hominum; cuius in Pauli conuersione exemplum luculentum habemus, in quo Theologos omnes, quibus veritas est cordi, adstipulatores me habere nullus dubito. Certè vester Tolosfanus affirmat{x} Christum, eiiciendo vendentes & ementes è templo, Regis potestatem gessisse; Sacerdotis autem, sese in hostiam offerendo. rendo.
III. ANIMADVERSIO.
Potestatem hanc Coactiuam, ut per se iniustam, itâ per multas Annorum centurias ignotam penitus fuisse.SECT. X.
PRimo in loco tempora Apostolorum recole, & tunc (fatente vestro Abulensi) constabit{4} Apostolos neque
{a} Ioh.10.11.
{b} Bellar.Recog. quæ supra.
{d} Apoc.19.16.
{x} Tolosfan. de Re-pub. lib.7. cap.1. pag.381.
{4} Abulens.Tom.11. in Matth.20. pag.304.

page.notes: Long s was printed as f in "Fruftrà" and "Pastor"-type words; corrected to plain s (Frustrà, suis). The superscript "c" after "vt" in the text and the "c" beside "Architectus" both appear; the mark is placed at "Architectus" beside its margin note, and the one after "vt" is doubtful. "quatenus" is followed by a doubtful symbol before "spirituale", transcribed as printed without a mark. The "Infelix" word is printed with a ligature-like abbreviation, read as Infelix. The "Tolosfan" note mark is a cross-like sign, read as x. The heading "SECT. X." is a section letter in the right margin. The catchword "crimi-" is removed from the text per rules, and the printed text ends with "neque". Printed note "Marsil.Venet.de-fens." is a split word in the margin, read as Marsil.Venet.de-fens.
